about: The operations the host library must make for four small calls, worked by hand by parcel HOST on 2026-11-24 from the blob format (model/weights.py's docstring), the register map (spec/undertone.toml) and docs/host/host.md section 3, and NOT by running the library or the model. Registers are named, with the word of a wide row (0 its lowest); the test turns a name into an offset with spec/constants.py. An operation is ["Read", register, word], ["Write", register, word, value], ["WriteMany", [[register, word, value], ...]], ["Allocate", bytes] or ["Fill", offset, bytes, the byte]. The sums: a negative weight is written as its 32-bit two's complement, so -1 is 4294967295, -2 is 4294967294, -3 is 4294967293 and -6 is 4294967290. 2^32 + 5 = 4294967301 is the words 5 and 1; 2^32 + 2 = 4294967298 the words 2 and 1; 2^62 = 4611686018427387904 the words 0 and 2^30 = 1073741824; 2^63 = 9223372036854775808. A blob's words are its rows (each filter's channels in order, oldest coefficient first), then its hidden units, then its head: configure is their count. Under s24x3 a filter reading channels 0 and 2 has the mask 1 + 4 = 5. A run of 70 frames has 70 x 32 = 2240 bytes of slots after a guard of 124 x 32 = 3968, 6208 in all, filled with the byte 0xA5 = 165; the fake backend's first buffer is at 65536, so krn_buffer is 65536 + 3968 = 69504. Before a run the four refusal registers are read in the chain's order, the source's, the injector's, the core's, the kernel's, and only then is the buffer allocated and filled (worked again by hand on 2026-11-24 after VHOST's B3: a refusal latched before a start is raised before anything below the seam changes).
